answer: An agent marketplace requires each active identity to lock a bond for 30 days before receiving a fixed job quota; the same funds cannot back two identities. Whether agents forecast a comet, design a terrace, or price marble, spawning more names grants no free capacity. An attacker seeking 1,000 quotas must immobilize 1,000 bonds for the full term, paying financing costs and losing access to that capital even if every fake account behaves honestly.
